parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   en-US (default): English

parameters.name: AddressId
parameters.description: The address ID. This ID uniquely identifies the address.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can specify a custom value for this parameter, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns delete-cloud-gtm-address --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-id addr-895182181143680000 --region cn-hangzhou
